title: tracks-playhead: cursor + multi-loop files on the Tracks tab

decisions.text: Multi-loop rendering: plan B (show ONE loop + a cyclic playhead), NOT tiling. Owner first proposed reusing the already-computed single-loop spectrogram by placing it into the loop positions (tiling). Rejected after measuring: every loop is acoustically identical and a spectrogram is STFT magnitude, so there is nothing to show beyond one loop; on extreme files (8000 loops x 0.79s) tiling is sub-pixel mush (~0.15px/loop across a ~1200px axis); and to keep the tiled axis aligned with the voice curves it would have to re-time the WHOLE stack (curves + wave + spectrum share one time column), whereas B keeps the stack consistent. Cost of B: a click seeks WITHIN the current loop only (the session axis is not expressible on a one-loop axis, but the status bar shows it). Plan A (tiling / session axis) stays possible if files with a handful of loops ever need it.

The playhead lives on its own overlay canvas above each view's body canvas. Measured: otherwise a moving cursor repaints the body every progress tick, and for the spectrogram draw() recomputes every visible tile's RGBA pixel-by-pixel (tileToImage, uncached) and re-blits it; GTrackView also reallocated its backing store (canvas.width=) each tick. Overlay is pointer-events:none so clicks still reach the body; a shared plotGeometry() per view is the single source of truth for the plot rect + time->x so the two canvases cannot drift. A canvas is a REPLACED element, so position:absolute+inset:0 does NOT stretch it (it stays 300x150) - the overlay needs explicit width/height:100%.

Playback-progress frequency is made adaptive to the schedule, in Pascal (Gnaural.exe), not in the UI. Target ~20 updates per loop, clamped to [100ms .. 1s]. Gnaural's control loop already ticks every 100ms (it polls getPlaybackPosition 10x/s); only the stdout EMIT is throttled to whole seconds, so raising the rate costs bytes, not CPU, and 10Hz is the natural ceiling. Computed once at load (totaltime/loops known) with no UI logic. After TP-D2 the client cost of a faster cursor is ~nil, so the Pascal emit throttle is the real granularity limiter. Deferred (TP3.1) - only needed for sub-second loops.

PREMISE CORRECTION (2026-07-16). The plan assumed the transport reports a SESSION-scale position (0..fullDuration) so the playhead runs off the one-loop axis. Wrong, and my error: I derived it from the duration formula (totalTime*loops in parseLoadedEvent) without checking the position path. Verified in our own Pascal: GnauralSynth resets FcurrentSampleCount to 0 at each loop boundary (GnauralSynth.pas:428) and decrements FcurrentLoop; getPlaybackPosition = FcurrentSampleCount/rate; no layer downstream accumulates. So the reported position is LOOP-LOCAL (0..loopDuration). Owner-observed on waves.gnaural (40s loop x10): the playhead cycles 0..40..0 and the status bar shows loop-local seconds. Consequences: the Tracks tab already handles multi-loop correctly; TP2.2's cyclic-playhead / mod-wrap is a no-op (gnaural already does it); TP2.3's 'position > duration' status-bar bug does not exist (position is loop-local <= one-loop duration). What is actually missing: (1) which loop you are in (gnaural tracks FcurrentLoop but never emits it); (2) sub-second loops stutter under the 1Hz Trunc progress throttle (TP3.1). Both are small and optional. TP-D1 stands in spirit (we do NOT tile/show the full session) but its 'cyclic playhead' half was already reality, not something to build. TP1.1 (overlay canvas) and TP2.1 (loopCount exposed) remain valid on their own merits.

Spectrum redraw regression, found + fixed while verifying TP2.2/TP3.1 (2026-07-16). The solo spectrum lane repainted on every playhead tick; TP3.1 (10Hz) made a latent 1Hz churn obvious. Root cause, pinned by instrumentation (not guessed): TracksPanel binds :analysis / :render to function-call results (laneSpectrogramAnalysis(...)) that mint a fresh object each render, and the panel re-renders at the playhead rate; SpectrogramView's deep watch on props.analysis keyed on the object REFERENCE, so it fired with contentChanged=false -> reconfigureAnalysis -> refetch -> a full per-pixel tile repaint. Fix: key those watches on the SERIALIZED content (JSON.stringify), so they fire only on a real change. Independent of multi-loop and of TP1.1 (the playhead was already on its own overlay). Commit 65ba9c6.

steps.title: Playhead onto its own overlay canvas (GTrackView / SpectrogramView / WaveformView)
artifacts: GTrackView/SpectrogramView/WaveformView: a second overlay canvas (pointer-events:none) above the body canvas; the body no longer draws the playhead. A shared plotGeometry(cssW,cssH) per view returns the plot rect + time window, used by both draw() and the new drawPlayhead().

playheadSec watch -> scheduleDrawPlayhead() (overlay only); view/resize -> both layers; mount draws both; unmount cancels both rAF ids. Overlay backing store reallocated only on real size change. Data gating preserved (gtrack hasData / waveform hasAudio / spectrogram frameCount>0).
CSS: overlay needs explicit width/height:100% + top/left:0 (a replaced canvas ignores inset:0 and stayed 300x150).
steps.verify: vue-tsc 0; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui 227/227; owner: playhead aligns with a click on all three views, click/drag/zoom still work through the overlay, cursor moves on play
evidence: Root cause measured, not guessed: SpectrogramView draw() calls tileToImage per visible tile per draw, and tileToImage (spectrogram-render.ts:231) allocates a fresh RGBA and runs a per-pixel colormap loop with NO cache; draw() ran on every playheadSec tick (watch). So a moving cursor recomputed the whole spectrogram image. GTrackView also reallocated its canvas each draw.

Regression during verification (owner: click at 3 min put the cursor near the start): the overlay canvas with position:absolute;inset:0 stayed at the replaced-element default 300x150, so its clientWidth was ~300 while the body was full-width; clicks (mapped via the body) seeked correctly but the playhead drew compressed into the left ~300px. Fixed with explicit width/height:100%. Owner-confirmed after the fix.
vue-tsc 0; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui 227/227. Commit 5d0135b.

steps.title: Plumb loopCount + loop duration to the Tracks stack
artifacts: use-gtrack-lanes.ts: exposes loopCount = max(1, floor(schedule.loopCount)) and fullDurationSec = durationSec * loopCount, alongside the unchanged one-loop durationSec. Reachable via useSharedGtrackLanes (ReturnType passthrough) as gtracks.loopCount / gtracks.fullDurationSec in TracksPanel and AudioPage.
steps.verify: single-loop files (loops=1, 223 of 296) render identical to before; loopCount reaches use-gtrack-lanes / TracksPanel
evidence: GnauralScheduleData already carries totalTimeSec (849) + loopCount (850) in protocol.ts; the composable took the raw dump but exposed only durationSec (= totalTimeSec, one loop).
The dump reports the TRUE loops (only the spectrogram render forces <loops>1>, not the schedule), so gtracks.loopCount is the real N (e.g. 8000 for CricketsAndFrogs).
No behaviour change: durationSec untouched, so single-loop files (223/296) render identically. vue-tsc 0; quasar build ok; GnauralCore bun test ui 227/227. Commit 8abfe1d.

steps.title: Loop indicator (N / M) — report the current loop from gnaural
artifacts: GnauralSynth.pas: getCurrentLoop = LoopCount - FcurrentLoop + 1 (clamped). GnauralApp.pas: playback_progress carries "loop". protocol AudioProgressEvent.loop?. gnaural-session parses it. audio store: remoteCurrentLoop -> audio.currentLoop (cleared on idle/exit). TrackStatusBar shows 'Петля N / M' when loopCount > 1 (denominator from gtracks.loopCount).
steps.verify: on a multi-loop file a 'loop N / M' readout tracks the current loop; single-loop files show nothing extra
evidence: gnaural resets its position to 0 each loop (TP-D4), so the client could not derive the loop number; the synth's FcurrentLoop is now surfaced end-to-end.

steps.title: Status-bar session display (was: fix position vs duration — NOT a bug)
steps.verify: the status bar never shows a position greater than the duration on a multi-loop file
steps.blockedReason: Dropped as a bug by TP-D4: position is loop-local, so the status bar already shows position <= one-loop duration (consistent). Only worth doing if we later want an explicit SESSION-scale readout (position/fullDuration); otherwise not needed.
evidence: Owner-observed on waves.gnaural: the status bar shows loop-local seconds within the loop duration; there is no position > duration. The earlier 'bug' was based on the wrong session-position premise (TP-D4).

steps.title: Adaptive playback_progress interval in Gnaural.exe (Pascal)
artifacts: GnauralApp.pas: playback_progress emit is throttled by position advance, not whole seconds. FprogressIntervalSec = TotalTime / 20 clamped to [0.1s, 1s], set per schedule in rebuildSynth; emit on first tick, on a loop wrap (position dropped), or once advanced by the interval. FlastProgressSecond (int) -> FlastProgressPos (double).
steps.verify: on a sub-second loop the cursor advances smoothly (~20 updates/loop), not in >1-loop jumps; single-loop and long schedules keep the current 1 Hz
evidence: At 1Hz a 0.79s loop advanced >1 loop per emit; the control loop already ticks at 100ms and polls the position, so a faster emit costs stdout bytes, not CPU (10Hz ceiling).

log.note: Initiative opened per owner request (thread 2026-07-15/16): make the Tracks tab handle multi-loop .gnaural. Plan B chosen over tiling (TP-D1) after measuring real files (296 presets; up to 8000 loops). Prereq TP-D2 (overlay-canvas playhead) done. Phases: 1 perf, 2 multi-loop playhead + status bar, 3 (optional) adaptive Pascal progress.

Playhead moved onto an overlay canvas in all three views; a moving cursor no longer repaints the body (esp. the per-pixel spectrogram recompute). Replaced-element canvas trap fixed with explicit width/height:100%. Commit 5d0135b. Owner-confirmed.
Exposed loopCount + fullDurationSec from the gtrack composable (plumbing); durationSec untouched so single-loop files are unaffected. Commit 8abfe1d.

TP-D4: plan premise corrected. Transport position is loop-local (verified in GnauralSynth.pas + owner-observed on waves.gnaural), so the playhead already cycles and the status bar is consistent. TP2.2 re-scoped to a loop-number indicator; TP2.3 dropped as a non-bug; TP3.1 (sub-second loops) is the main remaining optional item. TP1.1/TP2.1 stand.

TP2.2 (loop N/M indicator) + TP3.1 (adaptive progress rate) done, one Pascal rebuild. Plus TP-D5: fixed a spectrum-redraw regression (deep watch on a fresh-object analysis prop) that TP3.1 exposed. Commits: protocol c0512b0, spectrum fix 65ba9c6, feature 4c5428c. Phase 2 & 3 complete; the tracks-playhead initiative is done.
